name: Side chat
description: Ask an agent about its work with /btw, without interrupting it; each answer stays in its transcript as an aside.
author: Seti

commands.title: Ask aside
commands.description: Asks an agent's context, as a side chat: the answer comes from everything it saw and never interrupts it or reaches its conversation; Seti keeps it as an aside in the agent's transcript view. Use it for why an agent did something or what it found. It can take minutes and costs a model call.

question.description: The question for its context, such as why it chose an approach.

commands.title: List asides
commands.description: Lists the newest side questions asked of an agent and their answers, with who asked each and its id.

task.description: The agent whose asides to list.

commands.title: Clear asides
commands.description: Deletes one aside of an agent by its id, or every aside of the agent without one. Deleted asides are gone for good.

task.description: The agent whose asides to delete.

aside.description: The id of one aside to delete; leave it out to delete them all.

slashCommands.name: btw
slashCommands.description: Ask a side question; the agent is not interrupted

views.title: Side chat
views.description: Stays out of the agent's chat
